lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized in semi-vertical columns; posterior to the dorsal fin, blobs align in two primary horizontal rows with a third ventral row emerging towards the anterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, forming a localized grid where blobs serve as nodes within the vertical band trajectories.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible across the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are clustered primarily on the lower half of the dorsal fin's lateral surface, with the upper portion exhibiting more diffuse, lower-intensity pixel clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the first dorsal fin exhibits a significant, jagged indentation and irregular silhouette, indicating localized tissue loss or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge of the dorsal fin shows a distinct notch and irregular serration pattern that deviates from a smooth morphological curve.
